transformers.note: The model card shows no transformers inference example; conventions are inherited from the base architecture.

media._note: max_image_tiles stays at 4 rather than the 12 used in the model card's example: source frames are 640x480, and 12 tiles upsamples them 2.8x before slicing, multiplying visual tokens without adding information. Four tiles gives a budget comparable to what the other adapters spend on the same frame.
